calls.statement:
SELECT 
  ds.region,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as total_net_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) as total_receipts,
  SUM(fsl.quantity) as total_units
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND ds.region NOT IN ('Online', 'Head office')
GROUP BY ds.region
ORDER BY total_net_sales DESC

SELECT 
  ds.region,
  ds.store_id,
  ds.store_name,
  sc.closure_start_date,
  sc.closure_end_date,
  sc.weeks_closed
FROM ref_store_closure sc
JOIN dim_store ds ON sc.store_id = ds.store_id
WHERE ds.region NOT IN ('Online', 'Head office')
  AND sc.closure_end_date >= '2026-05-04'
ORDER BY sc.closure_start_date

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(fsl.net_amount) DESC) as rank,
  ds.region,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as net_sales_eur
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND ds.region NOT IN ('Online', 'Head office')
GROUP BY ds.region
ORDER BY net_sales_eur DESC
